correctness.rationale: Reconstructed normalized first-arrival exponentials and weighted empirical CDF inversion: centered increments over O(a_N) windows have variance ≤O(a_N³), giving Bahadur-type crossing expansion despite jump sizes possibly ~a_N. For s≤1/2 max_i i^-s/sqrt(H_N^(2s))→0, yielding Lindeberg joint bridge; for s>1/2 coefficients converge in l² to the persistent Bernoulli series. Exact H_N power sums produce sqrt(N), sqrt(N/logN), N^(1-s) scaling and stated constants; third cumulant is nonzero except theta=1/2, where fourth cumulant is -1/8 times coefficient fourth-power sum, excluding a Gaussian law. Independently evaluated Bernoulli cumulants at theta=1/4,1/2,3/4, with central fourth cumulant -1/8. Only fixed finite level sets and homogeneous clocks are proved.
